The '''High Council Chamber''', located within the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] was built during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] following the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] relocation to their ancestral [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]]. It was home to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] following the destruction of their original [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|chamber]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. A large domed chamber located on the second story of the Jedi Temple, the High Council chamber contained a large circular table with ten chairs surrounding it. Large, wooden statues of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] surrounded the table; a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] was wired into the center of the table.<ref name="TOR" />
